name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Legacy of the Necromancer
storyline:
The storyline focuses on restoring peace and stability after the fall of Sauron’s power in the north:

Aftermath of War: The shadow of Dol Guldur has lifted, but its legacy lingers. Strange forces and lingering corruption threaten the reclaimed lands.
Aid the Free Peoples:

Help Thranduil and the Elves secure Eryn Lasgalen from hidden dangers.
Assist the Men of Dale and Lake-town as they rebuild and face new threats from Easterlings.
Support the Dwarves of Erebor in defending their halls and trade routes.

Epic Themes:
The Black Book of Mordor continues with Chapters 5 and 6, drawing you into mysteries surrounding Dol Guldur and the remnants of the Necromancer’s influence. You’ll uncover secrets, repel invaders, and strengthen alliances among the northern kingdoms.
summary:
The Legacy of the Necromancer Quest Pack unlocks content for characters around level 115, taking players to the Strongholds of the North. This includes:

Regions:

Eryn Lasgalen (formerly Northern Mirkwood)
Dale-lands
Lake-town
Erebor

Content:

Over 100 quests and deeds
New reputation factions tied to Elves of Felegoth, Men of Dale, and Dwarves of Erebor

LOTRO Store Info: Available as a quest pack or included with VIP access.
